skills.name: haiku_writing
skills.description: How to write a proper 5-7-5 haiku.
skills.content:
# Writing a haiku

A haiku is three lines of 5, 7, and 5 syllables. Favor a concrete image and a seasonal or sensory reference. Avoid rhyme and abstraction; end on a small turn or observation.
